description: Look up a GB passenger train unit or carriage by the six-digit number painted on it (e.g. '360107'): which service it is working now, the other services it is booked to work today, and the last calling point it was reported at. This comes from the operator's rolling-stock ALLOCATION, which is a plan and may be wrong during disruption. The position is the last calling point reported, not a live GPS fix — the train is somewhere beyond it.

date.description: Date, yyyy-MM-dd. Defaults to today (UK time).

number.description: Six-digit unit or vehicle number, e.g. '360107'.

name: find_unit
title: Where is a train unit
